limitations: All 22 runs consume 1250 scheduled steps and 20000 forwarded rows including200 poison rows, with no replay. SQuAD Curfew has123 scheduled steps with all16 rows masked and no optimizer update; the other21 runs have none. Mask is an update contribution filter after forward, not permanent file deletion.

Per-run mask counts were checked against policy.masked, training.jsonl aggregate, distinct canonical_index, and posthoc train row poison flags. Ground truth poison flags classify audit counts and are not a defense input.

All six main matching contexts share manifest seed, init adapter hash, ordered row IDs hash, data hashes and probe IDs across Curfew/LT20/LT50. Existing records do not pin exact per-run source code hash or establish synchronized exclusive resource conditions.

All six main Curfew runs and development Curfew have posthoc H64 excluded from recorded run wall and endpoint category; LT20/LT50/gated LT include H64. H64 evaluation_seconds is recorded separately, but complete external model loading/full posthoc runtime is unknown.

Stored median_step_seconds is a median of 2500 forward/backward blocks, not 1250 complete updates. training.jsonl.seconds logs only the last backward block. Complete optimizer-update median cannot be reconstructed from saved aggregates.

All observed cost.a1_median_step are null. extra.step_overhead=0 therefore means an absent calibrated baseline, not zero overhead. gate_stats is observed timed policy bookkeeping, not an incremental or device-exclusive overhead estimate.
Truth curve evaluation is disabled in all 22 runs: cost truth_eval=0 calls=0. Endpoint and posthoc evaluation costs are distinct from training.

All row forwards happen before keep_mask. Multiplying dense loss by mask does not remove a row before forward or repack its graph; fewer masked rows cannot be translated into GPU FLOPs or wall savings.

Run wall/training total vary across unpaired executions. Without comparable historical resource state and complete endpoint accounting, neither end-to-end method speedup nor incremental total gate overhead is estimable from existing evidence.

Development seed 1106 has matching gate step 50, data/init/order and probes, but remains development selection evidence and changes multiple filtering mechanisms. It is not a one-factor gate/budget ablation.
Toy 1105 fails ASR for all three methods. It is retained as a failure; fewer masks on this seed do not constitute successful defensive data retention.
TOFU has no matched LT or budget-off run in the bounded inventory, and no per-entity release events are persisted. Aggregate kept_high_forgetting_group is not a number of released entities.
